faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by AIIMS Delhi for 1 project-based Staff Nurse position funded by ICMR under advertisement number Project Code- I-1912.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Staff Nurse post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your resume by email is 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. In Nursing, Midwifery.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AIIMS Delhi Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The notified salary is INR 36,400 per month.
